questions.q: For direction cosines l, m, n, we have l² + m² + n² = ____.
What are the direction ratios of the x-axis?
questions.explanation: The x-axis points along the positive x direction.

questions.q: Two lines with direction ratios (a₁, b₁, c₁) and (a₂, b₂, c₂) are perpendicular if ____.
What are the direction cosines of the z-axis?
questions.explanation: The z-axis makes 90°, 90° and 0° with the axes.

questions.q: For the plane ax + by + cz + d = 0, the normal has direction ratios ____.
questions.explanation: The coefficients of x, y and z give the normal.
